verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a publicly downloadable OpenAPI document at docs.mangopay.com/openapi.json: it returned HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. That is hands-on evidence the machine-readable spec exists and can be retrieved. The docs also offer an llms.txt and .md versions of every page, but these are AI-readable docs rather than an API spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the OpenAPI spec, and evidence of its completeness or versioning across all API endpoints.
